note: Open: the bands call `new_domain_volume` acceptable, because the domain is under 90 days old and sends more than 5,000 messages a week. The call is that it is wrong here: volume is level week on week, the earlier thirty-day window has an open rate much like the present one, so the domain has been sending to the same effect for two months, the grade has held at high, complaints and bounces are minimal and DMARC already enforces. That is a finished warm-up, and the type is about volume sent before there is a history. Warning this client of a warm-up risk would have it hold back a healthy programme. Had the volume just risen, or the grade been lower, the bands' answer would stand. It rests on the warm-up advice in M3AAWG's sender best practices, which is about sending history, not registration date; the reading of this domain is general practice.
